Via Lupe
Writing About

About

I am an academic librarian with interests in research, biblical languages, philosophy, and film. I studied Koine Greek and Hebrew at the graduate level, writing my thesis on the concept of lupe — grief as a productive, transformative force in Pauline thought.

This site is a place for careful thinking in short form. Not a blog, not an academic portfolio. Something closer to a commonplace book — thoughts worth keeping, written to be read.

Via lupe is the thread running through all of it. The journey grief makes possible.
